summary: Frontend-only regression pass completed for root sign-in and new Wallet/Send Money slice. Root sign-in loaded, /wallet and /send-money rendered cleanly, /earnings rendered, and both new entry points from Earnings navigated successfully.

integration_issues.issue: Console repeatedly logs Convex server errors for earnings:getMyTransactions and earnings:getOrCreateReferralCode while /earnings still renders fallback UI.

integration_issues.flow: Root sign-in completion in browser automation
integration_issues.issue: sign-in-btn tap triggers external OIDC flow but deterministic completion to authenticated in-app state remains third-party dependent.

issues: wallet method action chips use minHeight 40 (below 44px mobile touch target guidance).

action_items: Investigate Convex earnings query failures (getMyTransactions/getOrCreateReferralCode) so Earnings loads without server warnings.
Run one manual authenticated pass to fully validate OIDC sign-in completion and post-login route behavior.
Increase Wallet method action touch target height from 40 to >=44 for mobile ergonomics.
critical_code_review_comments: Route registration is correct in _layout.tsx for wallet and send-money; no dead-route issue found.
send-money.tsx uses multi-shape mutation retries with 'as any'; this is resilient short-term but can hide API contract drift and should be normalized once backend argument schema is finalized.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Credentials/auth docs were reviewed before testing. In signed-out automation, root sign-in baseline is stable; direct /wallet, /send-money, and /earnings routes render and Earnings buttons navigate correctly. Main remaining blocker is repeated Convex earnings query server errors.
rca_of_issue: RCA (integration): Earnings route is UI-stable because useSafeConvexQuery returns fallbacks, but backend query failures still surface in console. Repro: open /earnings in web preview; observe repeated warnings for earnings:getMyTransactions and earnings:getOrCreateReferralCode. Mitigation: align these Convex functions with unauth/default behavior or guard calls until auth/session prerequisites are met.
